question: In Experiment 3 the tube was kept at room temperature while the liquid was heated or cooled. Suppose the students repeated the 40 °C trial with the tube also heated to 40 °C. Based on the results of Experiment 3, the drain time would most likely have been:

options.A: shorter than 72 s, because the mixture would not have cooled toward 20 °C as it passed through the tube.
options.B: longer than 72 s, because the viscosity of the mixture would have increased as its temperature increased inside the tube.
options.C: shorter than 72 s, because a heated glass tube would have a much larger inner diameter.
options.D: longer than 72 s, because the mixture would have warmed further as it passed through the tube.
